PostToolUse.description: Emit a bounded Cortex progress/testing signal from a governed Claude tool completion; raw tool input/output is discarded.
Layer 1（确定性）：文件编辑后自动执行质量检查（Lint / 密钥扫描），失败时阻断

SessionStart.description: Validate private Cortex context for a governed Claude session; only the launcher writes task.accepted.

hooks.command: node -e "const f='.agent/plans/task-progress.md'; const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync(f)){console.log('[Cortex] Task progress loaded: '+f);}"

SessionStart.description: On session start, load .agent/memory/MEMORY.md index (≤200 lines / 25KB cap, topic files read on demand)
On session start, launch or renew the single runtime-continuity guard: catch up stale archives, archive every 2 hours, and exit after the 5-hour window
Ensure the singleton Dashboard Supervisor only when the project explicitly enabled automation; disabled projects perform zero writes and start no process

PermissionRequest.description: Report a governed Claude permission request without approving, denying, or changing permissions.

Notification.description: Convert Claude waiting-for-input notifications into Cortex task.input_required without forwarding notification text.

Stop.description: Record a non-terminal Stop; never infer completed or ready_for_review from it.
